trung.quote: Over the years, I've regularly reached out to TTC-Infotech whenever an IT issue came up. Every single time, the problem was resolved quickly and the engineers were friendly and professional. It made me realize: if the computer system breaks down and I can't find the cause, just call TTC-Infotech right away — because I know that if I don't, I'm only wasting time while the problem stays unsolved. As soon as I want it fixed, I call the help desk and it gets handled immediately. You guys do an awesome job.

toan.quote: We'd like to thank the TTC-Infotech team for the impeccable service they've provided us. There's simply no comparison between before and after working together. Previously, every power outage or system failure cost us hours of lost productivity. We went through nearly six different IT providers, all slow to respond, forcing us to manage IT on our own. If our server went down in the middle of the night, someone from the company had to come in and manually reboot it — our day-to-day infrastructure was a mess that pulled focus away from our core business. With the TTC-Infotech team, our fears about IT failures were eased thanks to their expertise, network improvements, proactive monitoring, and remote remediation capabilities. Whenever we need support, we get it through their 24/7 operations center, and we can always count on the team to answer our calls at any time of day. Now that disruptions are minimal, our staff can focus on their daily work. Thank you TTC-Infotech for the fast, reliable service — we look forward to continued success together!

dung.quote: We want to thank TTC-Infotech for becoming a true extension of our organization. With your support, our systems were quickly back up and running, and downtime dropped significantly thanks to the team's efficiency. As you know, our fast-growing needs and constantly evolving technology requirements demand that our business stays cutting-edge with minimal downtime. In our past experience with another IT provider, we kept running into power, performance, and server issues that were never fully resolved — finding a new managed IT partner became inevitable. When our server crashed, TTC-Infotech was fortunately able to step in immediately to handle the emergency. Choosing TTC-Infotech, we knew we'd made the right call — we no longer have to monitor our own servers and network ourselves, and can instead rely on an entire team of experts to keep up with the complex technology upgrades our industry demands. I'd happily recommend TTC-Infotech to any small, medium, or large business looking for fast service and a reliable team of experts with the best solutions for their industry.

minh.quote: Working with TTC-Infotech has been a wonderful experience. Thanks to the consistent, reliable response from their expert team, our office now operates far more efficiently. Having worked with a different IT provider before and struggled with slow service and response times, we needed a partner we could truly count on — one that could keep up with our ever-changing technology needs and implement a proactive IT plan we could rely on for the future. During a server crash with our former provider, we lost critical data. TTC-Infotech's team of professionals worked diligently to put in place a proper backup and disaster recovery plan and fixed the data-sync issues they uncovered along the way. TTC-Infotech lets us focus on what we do best — building our clients' brands. Thanks to their team, we no longer have to worry about maintaining our network, because we can fully trust TTC-Infotech to proactively monitor it for us.

hero.title: IT Consulting & System Design
hero.description: From consulting to system design — we help you build the infrastructure your business actually needs.

consulting.solutionDesc: TTC-Infotech brings experienced IT consultants to help you choose the right solution instead of getting lost among countless similar-looking options.
overview: Network infrastructure matters more than ever as virtualization, mobility, and cloud computing keep advancing. IT departments have to deliver high performance, availability, and security while workloads keep growing — but not every organization has the in-house expertise or resources to take on large-scale network design and deployment projects on its own.

Our consulting team helps you identify the right tools and solutions instead of having to weigh a sea of options that all promise similar results. IT should be the quiet system that supports your business, not a source of cost and risk.
list: Disaster Recovery — identifying, designing, and deploying a DR solution that meets your RPO/RTO requirements.
High Availability — keeping your critical services and applications continuously available.
Server & storage virtualization — doing more with less hardware using proven solutions from VMware, Microsoft, HPE, and Lenovo.
Public & private cloud — cloud solutions from VMware, Microsoft, and our own private cloud service.
Wired & wireless connectivity — switches, routers, and wireless solutions from Dell EMC, HPE Aruba, Cisco, and others.
Network & computer system audits — checking whether your infrastructure, policies, and operations are secure and up to standard.
Office 365 — deploying Microsoft's office suite together with email and collaboration tools.

hero.title: Installation Service
hero.description: From computers and servers to networking and UPS power — our engineers manage the entire installation process for you.

installation.solutionDesc: TTC-Infotech manages the entire installation of your new IT system, so you can put new equipment to use as soon as possible without worrying about the technical details.
overview: Installing a new IT system can feel like a challenge, but with the right support and advice it becomes much simpler. TTC-Infotech takes care of the full installation so you can stay focused on running your business day to day.

Every project is reviewed by highly qualified, experienced engineers to make sure the solution meets not just the technical requirements but your actual goals as a customer. We don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach — every company we work with gets its own fitting deployment plan.

sections.title: Computer, Server, Network & Virtualization Installation
paragraphs: Our engineers specialize in IT installations — from desktops and laptops to servers and complete network solutions.
We work closely with customers at every step, from initial design through installation management and the care that follows once the project is complete.

sections.title: UPS Power System Installation
paragraphs: With engineers trained and certified by APC, we install APC UPS systems, server racks, PDUs, and cabling.

TTC-Infotech holds APC Elite Partner certification, giving us the capability to supply equipment and deploy 3-phase UPS systems, cooling systems, and physical threat monitoring solutions from the network room to the data center — helping customers save on both cost and deployment time.

hero.title: IT System Repair & Troubleshooting
hero.description: Diagnosing and resolving issues across networks, computers, servers, and UPS power systems, so your business is back up and running as fast as possible.

repair.solutionDesc: The TTC-Infotech Service Center's engineers handle system issues around the clock, keeping disruption to your business to a minimum.
overview: Network, computer, server, and UPS power issues can happen at any time and directly affect your operations. Our team of more than 30 engineers, trained and certified by leading technology vendors, is ready to take on issues remotely or on-site.
For equipment that needs time to repair, our engineers can lend an equivalent replacement device so your work isn't interrupted while the repair is underway.

hero.title: Network & Computer Maintenance Service
hero.description: Periodic checks that catch risks early and keep your network and computer systems running smoothly.

maintenance.solutionDesc: Regular maintenance helps catch potential risks early, cuts down on unplanned incidents, and extends the life of your equipment.
overview: TTC-Infotech has been providing network and computer maintenance services to business customers for over 20 years. Periodic checks catch early warning signs before they turn into serious issues, reducing both downtime and unplanned repair costs.
Our vendor-trained, certified engineers follow a professional maintenance process and are available to support customers around the clock.

outsourcing.solutionDesc: IT outsourcing is a cost-effective solution for companies that want to streamline operations while keeping system quality high.
overview: Outsourcing shifts some or all operating responsibilities from an internal team to a dedicated service provider. It lets a business significantly cut recruitment, training, and HR management costs, lighten the internal workload, and stop worrying about salary and bonus policies — freeing up resources to focus on core operations.
TTC-Infotech provides comprehensive IT outsourcing, taking on the role of an on-call team of engineers and IT professionals so you never have to consider hiring on-site IT specialists again.

As an authorized warranty partner for Schneider Electric (APC) on 1-phase and 3-phase UPS products, and with equipment readily on hand, TTC-Infotech can process warranty requests quickly and conveniently.
